source: Phase 2 insights (p2_q01, p2_q02, p2_q03, p2_q04, p2_q05)
governance_note: Target approved by the user in Phase 3 (docs/json/target_approval.json, 2026-09-13). Bands are keyed to the per-client P(y=yes) probability. The low/medium boundary is the Phase 4 cost-optimal decision threshold (0.31, tuned on validation only against the cost matrix below), so the recommendation logic and the contact/no-contact decision never contradict each other: a client is predicted 'subscribe' exactly when the band is medium or high. Bands are half-open intervals [min, max); the last band is [min, 1.0]. Consumed in Phase 5 serving.
target_dependency: Interpretation of `probability` assumes the Phase 3 approved target is the binary term-deposit response. If a different target is approved, these bands must be re-derived.

risk_bands.recommendation: Deprioritize for active outreach this wave; no personalized push. Candidate for self-serve/digital channels only.
risk_bands.justification: Below the cost-optimal contact threshold (0.31): at the 20:1 FN:FP cost matrix, calling these clients wastes more effort than the marginal conversions justify. Consistent with the low-yield repeat-dialing flagged in Q05 (5.5% conversion at 6+ attempts).

risk_bands.recommendation: Include in the standard cellular campaign with up to two attempts.
risk_bands.justification: At or above the contact threshold (positive decision) but below premium-priority level; roughly the high-segment band from Q03 (students 31%, retirees 25%, cellular 14.7%).

risk_bands.recommendation: Priority outreach: assign best agents / cellular, personalized offer, contact within favorable macro window.
risk_bands.justification: Matches the warm-history (Q04: previously-contacted 63.8%, poutcome success 65.1%) and low-rate-window (Q02: 24-45%) conversions; these are the clients a missed contact most harms.

cost_matrix.assumption_note: No per-unit revenue/agent-cost figures exist in the dataset. Ratio is an explicit assumption grounded in Phase 2: it currently takes ~22.8 contacts to acquire one subscriber (Q05), so the value of a single subscriber (a funded term deposit) is treated as far greater than the marginal cost of one additional outbound attempt. The 20:1 ratio prioritizes recall (not missing would-be subscribers) and drives a lower decision threshold in Phase 4. To be revisited if the business supplies real unit economics.

operating_principles: Favor cellular over telephone for equal-propensity clients (Q01).
Weight campaigns toward favorable macro windows (Q02).
Cap attempts on low-propensity clients to avoid effort waste (Q05).
